Zachary's karate club

Source: R/graph-datasets.R
dataset_karate.Rd

The social network of 34 members of a university karate club observed by Zachary (1977), with the two factions that formed after the club split (17 members followed the instructor, "Mr. Hi"; 17 the administrator, "Officer"). Edges come from igraph::make_graph("Zachary"); faction labels follow the club attribute distributed with NetworkX. Node features are one-hot node indicators (34 columns), the featureless setting of Kipf and Welling (2017).

Usage

dataset_karate(features = c("identity", "degree", "none"))

Arguments

features

"identity" for one-hot indicators, "degree" for a single degree column, or "none".

Value

An undirected graph_data with 34 nodes, 78 edges and factor labels y.

References

Zachary, W. W. (1977). An information flow model for conflict and fission in small groups. Journal of Anthropological Research, 33(4), 452 to 473.

Examples

g <- dataset_karate()
table(g$y)
#> 
#>  Mr. Hi Officer 
#>      17      17
